sources.title: KraTUZen/dqn-SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The agent is trained using DQN, a value-based deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The environment is SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4, a classic Atari game where the agent must shoot down alien invaders.

sources.title: Bear-ai/dqn-SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DQN Agent playing SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 This is a trained model of a DQN agent playing SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
